I note for completeness that prior_deviation_flags is a lifetime counter and is not the trailing-90-day field POL-RD-06 names.

There is no phantom gantry line and no wrongly applied surcharge, so POL-RD-09(4) has nothing to refund and no billing-integrity referral arises. The trace has 46 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100% coverage, no gaps and a maximum gap of 0.0 seconds. The case is therefore decided on the measured figure, not escalated.
